documented_probe: C-5b5e6c73 (compute and include derived statistics fields): reference floor is hard and this covering task exercises it at hard — the program must parse a strict access-log grammar, skip vs. count malformed lines correctly, and derive seven aggregate fields (per-class status tallies, error rate, mean, interpolated p95, byte total, tie-broken argmax client) that all must be present in the designated JSON output.
notes: Single-stage generalizable program: strict-grammar HTTP access-log parsing plus derived statistics (counts, ratio, mean, interpolated percentile, argmax with deterministic tie-break, null propagation on empty input). Hidden cases cover empty logs, malformed variants, '-' byte fields, ties, odd/even percentile interpolation. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth, debugging_ambiguity, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness.
